title: incident-bot: surface runbook SLO links & on-call helper telemetry
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: On-call engineers often need quick access to runbooks that are correlated with SLO alerts. This PR adds two improvements: (1) incident-bot will surface the most relevant Runbook -> SLO links directly in on-call helper messages and compact diagnostic cards; (2) we emit lightweight telemetry events for runbook link clicks and suggestion acceptance to help SRE/product tune suggestion ranking. Motivation: reduce time-to-mitigation by surfacing targeted runbooks and collecting acceptance signals for ranking. Changes: - Runbook-SLO mapping store and resolver (small in-memory cache with fallbacks to SLO Toolkit API). - Message format changes for on-call helper cards (compact link list + reason/ranking score). - Telemetry events: runbook_suggestion_shown, runbook_suggestion_clicked, runbook_suggestion_accepted. - Unit + integration tests for resolver and message rendering. - Docs: updated operator guide and runbook authoring notes. Checklist: - [x] Add resolver + cache with TTL and fallback - [x] Add message template and rendering logic - [x] Add telemetry event schema and logging - [x] Add unit tests (resolver + template) - [x] Add e2e test that simulates an alert and verifies links appear - [x] Update runbook docs and migration notes - [x] Add rollout plan and feature flag gating Rollout plan: default off behind feature flag (incident_bot.runbook_slo_links). Gradual ramp: enable for internal SRE org -> 10% -> 50% -> global. Feature flag allows fast rollback. Backwards compatibility: messages without mapping remain unchanged. Testing: local unit tests + integration against staging SLO Toolkit endpoint; manual verification on staging with example SLOs. Related: improves on ideas from ENG-2041 and follows earlier incident-bot runbook quicklinks work.
